name: Manish Bhatia
tagline: Full-stack delivery powered by agentic coding — Cursor, Copilot, and Claude in the IDE.
availability: Open to collaboration, mentoring, and AI-augmented full-stack challenges
about: Hi, I’m Manish Bhatia — a passionate software developer and the creator of BlogWithCodes. With a strong background in full-stack development, I enjoy working with new technologies and solving complex challenges. Lately my focus is agentic coding: shipping real projects with AI agents inside the IDE while keeping architecture, security, and code quality under human ownership. I also integrate AI into products using Gemini and ChatGPT where it adds clear business value.
bio: I specialize in .NET Core, Angular, React, SQL Server, and Azure operations — plus AI product integrations with Gemini and ChatGPT, and agentic coding with Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude. Outside the IDE, I’m a trekker and traveller.
journey: I started as a Junior Developer focused on clean code and fundamentals. Over time I built expertise across .NET, Angular, React, and SQL Server — shipping applications from scratch, maintaining legacy systems, designing architectures, implementing secure APIs, and running applications on Azure. I’ve worked across monolithic and microservices architectures, mentored junior developers, and improved code quality on critical business systems. Today, as a Senior Software Developer, I lead delivery efforts and pair engineering judgment with agentic coding and practical AI integrations to move faster without sacrificing maintainability.
